reference.omp_ref_note: OpenMP target-offload program; g++ host fallback prints a timing then FAIL, so it is neither a correctness nor a performance baseline

timing_scope: per-pipeline kernel time: repeat back-to-back memset+sop+normalise pipelines between two synchronisations, divided by repeat; warmup excluded; result copy and host oracle outside timed region

alpaka_gpu.raw_samples_note: second independent run; median/min/max measured, individual samples not captured

alpaka_cpu.note: no usable reference baseline (see README limitations); indicative only

validation_matrix_pass.tolerance: |got-ref| <= 1e-3 + 1e-3*|ref| with NaN/Inf rejection; absolute term equals the pinned reference's own 1e-3 acceptance

repro_commands.cuda_ref: export PATH=/usr/local/cuda-12.6/bin:$PATH CUDA_HOME=/usr/local/cuda-12.6; cd /root/stddev-ref-src; nvcc -std=c++17 -Xcompiler -Wall -arch=sm_70 -O3 -use_fast_math main.cu -o stddev_cuda_ref; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=3 ./stddev_cuda_ref 4096 4096 100
repro_commands.alpaka_cuda: cmake --preset rel-cuda-nvcc-gcc -DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=70 -Dalpaka_COMPILE_PEDANTIC=ON .; cmake --build build/rel-cuda-nvcc-gcc --target stddev_alpaka -j; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=3 ./build/rel-cuda-nvcc-gcc/benchmark/stddev/stddev_alpaka --D 4096 --N 4096 --repeat 100 --samples 7
repro_commands.alpaka_cpu: cmake --preset rel-host-cpu-gcc -Dalpaka_COMPILE_PEDANTIC=ON .; cmake --build build/rel-host-cpu-gcc --target stddev_alpaka -j; OMP_NUM_THREADS=8 ./build/rel-host-cpu-gcc/benchmark/stddev/stddev_alpaka --D 4096 --N 4096 --repeat 50 --samples 7

reference_provenance_note: reference sources kept outside the repository at /root/stddev-ref-src on rosi_v100
